Detailed Description

POSIX File System option group.

Covers access(), chdir(), getcwd(), link(), mkdir(), pathconf(), rmdir(), stat(), truncate(), unlink(), and related filesystem functions.

Typedef Documentation

◆ DIR

typedef struct zvfs_dirstream DIR

Directory stream type.

An open directory stream is backed by a file descriptor, so it inherits the kernel object permission model and works from user mode. The type is intentionally incomplete here; dirfd() returns the descriptor.

Definition at line 47 of file dirent.h.
